results.text:
# Dixon Ticonderoga Tri-Write Triangular Standard Size No.2 Pencils, Yellow, 12 Count (13856)
Brand: Ticonderoga
Category: Writing & Correction Supplies > Pencils

## Features
Triangular ergonomic shape adds comfort and promotes proper pencil grip; Box of 12 number 2 HB yellow pencils; Latex-Free eraser for smudge-free corrections; Pma certified non-toxic; Earn free supplies - visit the prang power website for program information

## Pricing & Reviews
Rated 3.2 from 9 reviews.
Top review: I thought a triangle pencil would be kind of weird but I really do love it. It helps with perfect placement of your fingers, making it easy to write with. They also don't roll off the desk as easily either. They write nicely too. Not sure I could ever go back to the "regular" ones again.Only received 11 out of 12 pencils and the box was broken. I hope the lead is not broken also.I'm thankful these exist. I have a child whohas small motor issues that include difficulty with pencil grip. For him, these tri-writes make the pencil grip a bit easier. Ticonderoga makes excellent pencils. Well worth the price paid.Love these pencils. I won't use anything else. The triangular shape allows for proper placement of the pincer grip which reduces hand fatigue while writing.Love these pencils - great value and used them for required school supplies.These are horrible!!! They are hollow!!!! That's correct, there is absolutely NO lead in these pencils!!!!! Someone please tell me how you are supposed to write with these ???!!!!!!!Great Pencils

## Description
With a rich heritage, and origins dating back to 1795, the Dixon Ticonderoga company throughout history has made its mark through quality, integrity, respect and perseverance. Today Dixon Ticonderoga continues to make its mark manufacturing and marketing writing instruments, art supplies and tools for self-expression. The Ticonderoga tri-write triangular standard size pencil is the new shape in pencils from the people who know pencils best. Write more comfortably with this ergonomically perfect, triangular shaped number 2 pencil. PMA certified non-toxic, it features an exclusive graphite core formula which gives you extra smooth performance. The top quality eraser provides easy, clean corrections. More than a writing and art products company, Dixon Ticonderoga empowers people to take conscious and subliminal thoughts, facts, ideas and dreams, and preserve them using tools that are simply extensions of themselves.

results.text:
# Ticonderoga Tri-Write Triangular Pencils, Wood-Cased #2 HB Soft, Yellow, 12-Pack (13856)
Brand: Ticonderoga
Category: Pencils > Wooden Lead Pencils

## Features
Triangular shape to promote proper grip; Exclusive #2 graphite formula provides extra smooth performance; Top quality, latex-free eraser provides easy, clean corrections; Satin smooth finish enhances writing comfort; PMA certified non-toxic

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 2.49 USD.
Rated 4.7 from 2702 reviews.
Top review: Phnonemal design to assure proper hold for beginner writers as well as a reminder for little writers. Love these!I was a bit frustrated when I saw these expensive pencils on our first grader's supply list. However, after reading about how important grip is to proper handwriting and watching my daughter's handwriting improve, I AM SOLD!This pencil's shape encourages proper grip without the use of those rubber sleeves. By the time we run out of a 12 pack of these pencils, I am hopeful that my daughter will have committed holding a pencil properly to her muscle memory. If not, I'll buy another set because these were absolutely worthy it!Easy to hold and comfortable. My kids prefer these to regular pencils.Love that these pencils are triangular shaped pencils. They are perfect for getting your little one to hold pencil properly and write better. I recommend them to all who need the help or struggle with holding their pencil properly.Muy buenosThe pencil boxes were damaged because they were sent in soft package. I love these pencils for my fourth-grade niece but had to carefully tape the bottom of both boxes to keep the pencils in the battered boxes.Sharp, easy to hold with a great eraser!Best pencil money can buy! so comfortable.Probably the best pencil in the World! (said in Clarkson voice). Seriously though, it's as smooth as silk. I especially like the rounded triangular cross-sectional shape, which may be designed for beginners but is eminently comfortable; fine for not only toddlers but also this 66 year old perfectionist. My favourite writing implement - ever.Save your money and buy your pencils elsewhere. These junky things shredded in the sharpeners (we tried multiple sharpeners on multiple pencils). The wood would break apart and long sections of graphite would break off. After multiple attempts we were able to get one pencil sharp, but by that time there were only six inches left! Shop somewhere else, as this purchase was an exercise in frustration and a huge waste of money.I'm happy to finally found the triangular pencils which can be sharpened with regular pencil sharpener!I used to buy the big black triangular pencils for our kids (6 and 3). They are great to learn how to hold a pencil properly with a kid's tiny hand. But it was not fun to sharpen with an exact knife every single time. And the older one needed to get used to a regular sized pencils, but she still had a tendency to grip weirdly with a regular circular pencil if I didn't remind her.So this standard sized triangular pencils solved my problem. I love that they can be sharpened with regular pencil sharpeners and still in a triangular shape. Now kids can sharpen on their own without any danger, and still get a good habit of holding pencil correctly.Even for adults, I find that I don't feel tired holding a pencil with this shape.Also, the eraser at the end works well. I don't like when some erasers at the end of pencils just smudges the writing, but these ones do erase.Good pencils, but I'd suggest buying them from a stationary store. These pencils have a nice triangular shape to help young children develop a proper pencil grip. The problem is that the lead inside the pencils is broken. It takes a lot of sharpening to get to a section where the lead inside isn't broken and the pencil can actually be used. Because of how frequently we're sharpening the pencils, these won't last long before the whole pack is sharpened down to a nub. I suspect it's not the pencils themselves that are the problem, but the Amazon delivery drivers who are rough with the parcels. Good pencils, but next time I'll buy them from a bricks and mortar store.Some of the led broke but that’s because the pencils were handled quite roughly by my two younger boys. But I LOVE these pencils. They were recommended to me and I and so happy with that recommendation. My 3 year old is holding all his pencils correctly just by using these pencils for a few months. My ADHD 5 year old who has lazy tendencies when it comes to writing even commented how easy and comfortable they were to hold! I’m a very happy customer.

## Details
Model: ‎13856

## Description
Ticonderoga has a tradition of fine quality writing instruments in the US for over 100 years. The exclusive graphite core features a proprietary formula focusing on graphite mined from carefully controlled sources to deliver extra smooth performance. The naturally ergonomic, triangular shape helps teach correct pencil grip. Premium wood harvested from responsibly managed sources provides smooth, even sharpening with minimal breakage. Teachers prefer Ticonderoga for its dependability and craftmanship.

## Description

The tri-angle pencil pack includes 12 #2 triangular pre-sharpened pencils with latex-free erasers, offering smooth, consistent lines that are perfect for writing, drawing, and standardized testing. The triangular body provides a comfortable ergonomic grip while naturally promoting proper hand positioning and reducing hand fatigue. Additionally, this shape prevents the pencil from rolling off your table. Made from durable wood, these pencils feature easy clean sharpening and thick, break-resistant graphite lead, which results in less sharpening and produces dark, long-lasting, readable, and consistent strokes. Each pencil comes pre-sharpened, allowing you to start writing or drawing immediately. This feature saves time and effort, making these pencils convenient for both classroom and personal use. They are suitable for a variety of tasks, from note-taking and homework to drawings and professional writing, making them ideal for students, teachers, artists, and as bulk supplies for schools or offices. Each pack includes 12 pencils. Sold as 24 packs for a total of 288 pencils.
